Repo: https://github.com/clawdbot/clawdbot

GitHub issues/comments/PR comments: use literal multiline strings or `-F - <<'EOF'` (or $'...') for real newlines; never embed "\\n".

Source: `src/` (`src/cli`, `src/commands`, `src/provider-web.ts`, `src/infra`, `src/media`); tests colocated `*.test.ts`; docs `docs/`; output `dist/`; extensions `extensions/*`. Keep plugin-only deps in extension `package.json`; do not add them to root `package.json` unless core uses them. Installers: sibling `../clawd.bot` (`public/install.sh`, `public/install-cli.sh`, `public/install.ps1`).

Consider **all** built-in + extension channels for shared logic. Core docs: `docs/channels/`; core code: `src/telegram`, `src/discord`, `src/slack`, `src/signal`, `src/imessage`, `src/web`, `src/channels`, `src/routing`; channel plugins include `extensions/msteams`, `extensions/matrix`, `extensions/zalo`, `extensions/zalouser`, `extensions/voice-call`.

Docs: Mintlify, docs.clawd.bot. Internal links in `docs/**/*.md`: root-relative, no `.md`/`.mdx`; anchors use root-relative paths. When Peter asks for links, reply with full `https://docs.clawd.bot/...` URLs. When touching docs, end reply with referenced `https://docs.clawd.bot/...` URLs. README links must be absolute. Docs must be generic: no personal device names/hostnames/paths; use placeholders like `user@gateway-host` and “gateway host”.

Runtime: Node **22+**; keep Node + Bun paths working. Install: `pnpm install`; also `bun install` (keep `pnpm-lock.yaml` + Bun patching in sync when touching deps/patches). Prefer Bun: `bun <file.ts` / `bunx <tool>`. Dev CLI: `pnpm clawdbot ...` or `pnpm dev`; Node supports `dist/*` and production. Build: `pnpm build`; lint/format: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format`; tests: `pnpm test`, coverage `pnpm test:coverage`. Live: `CLAWDBOT_LIVE_TEST=1 pnpm test:live`; `LIVE=1 pnpm test:live`; Docker: `pnpm test:docker:live-models`, `pnpm test:docker:live-gateway`; onboarding: `pnpm test:docker:onboard`. Full kit: `docs/testing.md`.

TypeScript ESM; prefer strict typing; avoid `any`. Oxlint/Oxfmt; run `pnpm lint` before commits. Add brief code comments for tricky/non-obvious logic. Keep files concise; extract helpers, not “V2” copies; use existing CLI option patterns and `createDefaultDeps`; aim under ~700 LOC (under ~500 when feasible). Match tests: `*.test.ts`, e2e `*.e2e.test.ts`; run `pnpm test` (or `pnpm test:coverage`) before pushing logic changes. Pure test additions/fixes generally do **not** need a changelog entry unless user-facing behavior changes or requested.

Naming: **Clawdbot** product/app/docs headings; `clawdbot` CLI/package/binary/paths/config keys. stable: tagged `vYYYY.M.D`, npm `latest`; beta: `vYYYY.M.D-beta.N`, npm `beta`; dev: moving `main`.

Mobile: before using a simulator, check connected real iOS + Android devices and prefer them. **Device checks:** before testing, verify connected real devices (iOS/Android) before reaching for simulators/emulators. “restart iOS/Android apps” means rebuild (recompile/install) and relaunch. iOS Team ID: `security find-identity -p codesigning -v`; fallback `defaults read com.apple.dt.Xcode IDEProvisioningTeamIdentifiers`.

Commits: `scripts/committer "<msg>" <file...>`; avoid manual `git add`/`git commit`. Use concise action-oriented messages; group related changes; avoid unrelated refactors. Changelog: latest released version at top, no `Unreleased`; after publishing, bump version and start a new top section. PRs summarize scope, tests, user-facing changes/new flags.

PR review: use `gh pr view`/`gh pr diff`; do **not** change branches. Prefer one `gh pr view --json ...`; run `gh pr diff` only when needed. Before review of pasted Issue/PR: run `git pull`; if local changes or unpushed commits, stop and alert user. **Review mode (PR link only):** read `gh pr view/diff`; **do not** switch branches; **do not** change code.

Landing: create integration/temp branch from `main`, bring PR commits (prefer squash/rebase; merge if safer), apply fixes, changelog (+ PR #, thanks), run `pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test` locally before committing, commit, merge back to `main`, `git switch main`, delete temp branch; contributor must be in git graph. If squash, add author as co-contributor. If review is followed by work, land via merge/squash, no direct-main commits, and always add author as co-contributor. Merge comment must explain exactly what was done and include SHA hashes. New contributor: add avatar to README “Thanks to all clawtributors”; run `bun scripts/update-clawtributors.ts` if missing, then commit regenerated README. Issue/PR work: changelog reference; PR changelog includes number and thanks. End GitHub Issue/PR tasks by printing full URL.

`sync`: if dirty, commit all changes (sensible Conventional Commit), then `git pull --rebase`; if conflicts cannot resolve, stop; otherwise `git push`.

Web creds: `~/.clawdbot/credentials/`; rerun `clawdbot login`. Pi sessions: `~/.clawdbot/sessions/`; base not configurable. Env: `~/.profile`. Never commit or publish real phone numbers, videos, or live configuration values. Use obviously fake placeholders. Never edit `node_modules` (global/Homebrew/npm/git installs too). Skill notes go in `tools.md` or `AGENTS.md`. Never update Carbon. `pnpm.patchedDependencies` requires exact versions. Patching dependencies (pnpm patches, overrides, or vendored changes) requires explicit approval; do not do this by default.

Release: read `docs/reference/RELEASING.md` and `docs/platforms/mac/release.md`; do not ask routine questions answered there. Do not change version numbers without operator’s explicit consent; always ask permission before running any npm publish/release step. Version locations: `package.json`; Android `apps/android/app/build.gradle.kts`; iOS `apps/ios/Sources/Info.plist`, `apps/ios/Tests/Info.plist`; macOS `apps/macos/Sources/Clawdbot/Resources/Info.plist`; `docs/install/updating.md`; `docs/platforms/mac/release.md`; Peekaboo projects/Info.plists. Signing keys external; follow release docs. Notary vars: `APP_STORE_CONNECT_ISSUER_ID`, `APP_STORE_CONNECT_KEY_ID`, `APP_STORE_CONNECT_API_KEY_P8`.

Rebrand/legacy warnings: `clawdbot doctor` (`docs/gateway/doctor.md`). “makeup” = “mac app”. Gateway runs only as menubar app; restart via Clawdbot Mac app or `scripts/restart-mac.sh`; verify/kill with `launchctl print gui/$UID | grep clawdbot`. **When debugging on macOS, start/stop the gateway via the app, not ad-hoc tmux sessions; kill any temporary tunnels before handoff.** Logs: `./scripts/clawlog.sh`. Do not rebuild macOS app over SSH; rebuild directly on Mac.

**Multi-agent safety:** do **not** create/apply/drop `git stash` entries unless explicitly requested (this includes `git pull --rebase --autostash`). Assume other agents may be working; keep unrelated WIP untouched and avoid cross-cutting state changes.
**Multi-agent safety:** when the user says "push", you may `git pull --rebase` to integrate latest changes (never discard other agents' work). When the user says "commit", scope to your changes only. When the user says "commit all", commit everything in grouped chunks.
**Multi-agent safety:** do **not** create/remove/modify `git worktree` checkouts (or edit `.worktrees/*`) unless explicitly requested.
